title: Deshama Na Deshama – Abhishek Devadas Telugu Christian Lyrics

english: Desama na desama.. desama bhaartha desama..
emi ee vedhana neekela ee shodhana
neevu thappina maargame neeku shaapamai maarenaa
prabhu drushtilo nee paapam bahu ghoramaipoyenaa
yesu raakanu kanuma dhaiva rakshana pondhuma
desama na priya desama.. desama bhaaratha desama
dhaiva ugratha prakatinchagaa prathi mokaalu vangenu..
raajule dheenulai aa dhevuni mokkaga dhevuni rakshana aa desaanni cherenu
nee paapaanni vidichi dhaiva rakshana pondhuma.
2. Nee dhanam nee balam ellappudu niluchuna
adhi nee dhoshame.. nee paapa phalithame..
aa prabhu ninnu kshamiyinchi icchunu rakshana
yesu raakanu kanumaa dhaiva rakshana pondhumaa
Desama naa priya desama..desama bhaaratha desama..
yesey maargamu… yesey sathyamu… yesey jeevamu… yesey sarvamu..
intro: Deshama Na Deshama is the latest Christian Telugu worship song written, tuned and sung by Bro Abhishek Devadas and music composed by Enoch Jagan. This song was released on August 12, 2020 through Face of God Youtube Channel.
